item.title: Senior Thermal Engineer (m/w/d)
item.dc:creator: Acme
item.description: Senior Thermal Engineer (m/w/d) At Acme Space we build satellites that link the world. You will design, analyse and test the thermal control system of our spacecraft, own thermal models in ESATAN and run thermal vacuum campaigns together with our test team. Degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering Five years of spacecraft thermal design Fluent German and English We offer a team of 40 engineers in Oberpfaffenhofen, flexible hours, 30 days of leave & a relocation package.
